# Update on global technology issue


Staff Writer


Oct 6, 2026 1:15pm


Delta systems are stabilizing after a limited global technology issue that affected data connectivity to some of our systems behind-the-scenes.


Delta teams are working to keep our operation moving safely as systems return to normal. We appreciate our customers’ patience and understanding. Customers should use the Delta app and delta.com for the latest information about flights.
